materialFindings.finding: The CONTENT expansion contract requires the existing inline expansion to remain unchanged, while the current uncommitted WorkPage.jsx replaces it with a native dialog modal.

The separate web-masonry-modal design explicitly limits that work to prototypes/web-masonry-modal and forbids main-app changes, so the production modal change has no matching durable authority in the inspected documents.
The plan's Python unittest command is not runnable in the repository layout and its default Python dependency assumption is undocumented.

fullSuiteFailureNames: WEB desktop expands inline across all three columns and scrolls long source media
every category reuses the full-width inline expanding feed with its own accent color
opening a project preserves the clicked card position without a visible page scroll
WEB expansion stays on the clicked masonry row and nearest valid column
closing an inline detail restores the card to its pre-open viewport position
project details use one modal scroll surface while the background stays locked

harnessObservation.decision: Do not declare the CONTENT work item or full project complete and do not repair or revert the modal transition until its intended production status is resolved.

limitations.note: This is material real-use evidence for retained guardrail behavior, not promotion evidence for the candidate design router or the whole harness.
